action.details: Opens the Wayback Machine capture timeline for the selected URL without making a background API request.
action.exampleOutput: The Wayback Machine opens its capture timeline for the selected URL.
action.name: Open in Wayback Machine
action.privacySummary: The selected text is sent to web.archive.org as part of the URL when you run the action.
action.requirements: Online Actions must be enabled. Select one complete HTTP or HTTPS URL.
action.summary: Find archived captures of a selected web URL.
